title: Evals Sentinel: Consolidated Notice Hub for Model/Config Change Regressions
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build a single-pane "Notice Hub" in the Console Evals experience that consolidates regression signals triggered by model or config changes, automatically deduplicates noisy alerts, enriches notices with diffs and failing eval examples, and provides curated routing rules for Slack and PagerDuty. The hub should enable fast triage, automated suppression windows for known churn, and an API for programmatic integrations.
acceptance_criteria: Console includes a new 'Notice Hub' view that lists active regression notices with a dedupe fingerprint and score
Each notice page shows model/config diff, top 3 failing evals with input+expected+actual, and recent run history (last 7 runs)
Deduplication algorithm groups alerts from the same root cause with false-positive suppression rate > 70% in initial dataset
Routing rules support per-team Slack channels and PagerDuty escalation paths; one-click 'Send to PD' from notice
Noise suppression window feature to mute repeat notices for a configurable period with audit logs
APIs for pulling notice payload and pushing manual annotations (triage, false_positive, resolved)
End-to-end tests for dedupe fingerprints and routing rules included in CI
implementation_tasks: Define dedupe fingerprint schema (model id, config diff hash, top failing eval signatures)
Backend: notice aggregator service that consumes eval-change events and produces notices with enrichment payloads
Backend: store notice history and suppression state in notices DB with retention policy
API: notice REST endpoints (list, get, ack, annotate, escalate)
UI: Notice Hub list, notice detail pane, quick actions (ack, mute, escalate, mark false positive)
Integrations: Slack card format + channel routing config UI
Integrations: PagerDuty event creation with dedupe key and manual escalation flow
Telemetry: add notice_created, notice_deduped, notice_escalated, notice_muted events
QA: flaky-eval heuristics tests and e2e routing smoke tests
Docs: runbook + triage checklist + console help text
api_contracts: GET /api/v1/evals/notices?state=active -> list of notices with dedupe_key and top_failures
POST /api/v1/evals/notices/:id/escalate -> create PagerDuty event with dedupe_key
infra_requirements: Pub/Sub topic for eval-change events with at-least-once delivery
Kubernetes deployment for notice-aggregator with horizontal autoscaling
Redis for fast dedupe-key lookups and short-term suppression windows
Long-term storage in notices-postgres cluster with partitioning by month
rollout_plan: Phase 0: behind-feature-flag release; wire up to staging evals stream only
Phase 1: enable for 5 pilot teams; iterate on dedupe heuristics and Slack formatting
Phase 2: enable PagerDuty integration for pilot on-call rotations and collect escalation metrics
Phase 3: GA for all teams with default routing templates and docs
comments: 2026-03-02: PM review completed. Decided to prioritize dedupe by 'config diff hash + top failing eval signature' rather than user-assigned tags to reduce ops friction.

2026-03-06: Design feedback: include quick examples (input/expected/actual) inline to reduce context switching to run details.
2026-03-09: Security review queued for PagerDuty webhook secrets; KMS integration recommended for PD keys (follow up ticket).
2026-03-10: Added API contract for manual annotation and escalate endpoints after sync with SDK team.
